column1: # fpga.sh output (yosys 0.52 synth_ecp5 and synth_xilinx -family xc7 -flatten; rerun 2026-11-18 after the flatten fix): file, module, ecp5 LUT4 (carry cells as 2), ecp5 FF, ecp5 MULT18X18D, ecp5 RAM cells, xc7 LUT, xc7 FF, xc7 DSP48E1, xc7 RAMB (LUTRAM not counted).  The ECP5 columns are identical to the first run.  xc7 vcmp_mw (89,804 LUT6) is a mapping artifact of the behavioural description, not of the hierarchy: vcmp2 in vecw.v (626) replaces it in the strip study.
